pluss::subsp::stats::ts::LjungBoxResult¶

Result of ts::ljung_box.

LjungBoxResult holds one entry per element of LjungBoxOptions::lags, each field a Series of that length.

Fields¶

Field

Type

Default

Meaning

lags

pluss::Series

—

The lag sets that were tested.

stat

pluss::Series

—

The Ljung–Box statistic for each.

pvalue

pluss::Series

—

The upper-tail chi-squared probability of each statistic (small: not white noise).

dof

pluss::Series

—

The degrees of freedom: lags minus model_df.

Guidance¶

The defaults are a sensible starting point; change a field only for the reason its row gives.
